verdict.rationale: DBOS has static reference docs (CLI, DBOSClient), and its Conductor API is described as OpenAPI-documented. Nothing in the pack shows an interactive API explorer or runnable in-docs examples. An OpenAPI description could be used to build such an explorer, but that is a building block, not the capability itself, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec at the standard docs paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
